entities.name: PMID:25076170
observations: 2014 rat study of environmental enrichment after experimental infant pneumococcal meningitis; PubMed abstract reports recovery from memory deficits.

entities.name: Enrichment memory recovery
observations: In rats inoculated intracisternally with Streptococcus pneumoniae on postnatal day 11, enrichment from days 21–60 restored training-to-test memory differences in open-field habituation and step-down inhibitory avoidance tasks.

entities.name: Environmental enrichment
observations: Post-weaning housing in a large multilevel cage with ramps, running wheels, and varied objects was used from postnatal day 21 to 60 in the rat meningitis study.

entities.name: Experimental pneumococcal meningitis
observations: Infant rat model induced by intracisternal Streptococcus pneumoniae inoculation on postnatal day 11.
